issues.issue: Can an appellate court vary a fit sentence to avoid IRPA collateral immigration consequences the sentencing judge did not consider?
issues.applicant_position: The two-year sentence should be reduced by one day to avoid the loss of appeal rights under the IRPA.
issues.respondent_position: Crown conceded two years less a day is within the fit range and is what the judge would have imposed.
issues.result_quote: It is therefore appropriate to grant the variation of the sentence sought by the appellant.

issues.issue: Was the Court of Appeal right to refuse the one-day reduction because of the offender's prior record or abuse of hospitality?
issues.applicant_position: Refusing the reduction on prior record or abuse of hospitality grounds was an error.
issues.result_quote: It was wrong for the Court of Appeal to refuse the one-day reduction solely on the basis that the appellant had a prior criminal record
